ohtani.title: Emmet Sheehan's superb outing fuels Dodgers' 6-3 win
ohtani.blurb: Teoscar Hernández belts a three-run homer and Emmet Sheehan strikes out 10 to lead the Dodgers over the Reds, 6-3

imanaga.title: Pete Crow-Armstrong lifts two homers in Cubs' win
imanaga.blurb: Pete Crow-Armstrong lifts two home runs and an RBI triple to propel the Cubs to an 8-4 win over the Braves

yoshida.title: Sonny Gray, Wilyer Abreu shine in 4-0 shutout win
yoshida.blurb: Seven innings of shutout ball from Sonny Gray and Wilyer Abreu's 22nd homer of the year lead the Red Sox to a 4-0 win over the Pirates

okamoto.title: Josh Jung, Wyatt Langford lead Rangers to 6-2 win
okamoto.blurb: Josh Jung hammers a solo home run and Wyatt Langford hits an RBI double to lead the Rangers to a 6-2 win over the Blue Jays

murakami.title: Miguel Vargas' home run fuels White Sox 3-1 win
murakami.blurb: Miguel Vargas launches a solo homer and steals his 20th base to keep the White Sox playoff hopes alive in their 3-1 victory over the Tigers

matsui.title: Ethan Salas walks it off in 7-6 Padres win
matsui.blurb: A two-RBI night from Samad Taylor and a walk-off single from Ethan Salas propel the Padres to a 7-6 extra-inning win over the Marlins
